metadata.title: Mailozaurr
metadata.description: PowerShell email toolkit for SMTP, IMAP, POP3, Microsoft Graph, Gmail, SendGrid, Mailgun, and Amazon SES, with message-file, PST/OST archive, signing, and encryption workflows.
